decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 27 August 2003, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

	The proposed single-storey outbuilding to the rear of the dwellinghouse at a width of 7.2m, depth of 5m and with a pitched roof at a height of 4m, qualifies as Class E, permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995. 

The development, therefore, does not require planning permission.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a detached single storey building for use as a gym and garden store with shower and wc to rear of dwellinghouse.
